tips.title: Ensure scripts have no user interaction
tips.body: The application must be adapted to run without user input to prevent it from falling.

tips.title: Configure PW server executable parameters
tips.body: Define watch folder, project number (script), priority, and file type in PWserver.exe.

tips.title: Monitor configuration for client interaction
tips.body: Use PWMonitor.exe to show information to clients during the process, with log files having a .PWlog extension.

tips.title: Start PW server application on the server
tips.body: Execute PWserverStart.exe to keep the application running on the server.

tips.title: Start PW server application from the client
tips.body: Use the 'Start script on server' function to start the server application directly from the client.

tips.title: Enable batch mode to skip message boxes
tips.body: Use the 'Batch mode' function to skip all message boxes during the process.

tips.title: Define server mode status
tips.body: Manage the status of the PW Server Monitor using the 'Define server mode' function.

tips.title: Change server mode status dynamically
tips.body: Use the 'Define server mode' function in the script to change the status at any time.
